title: 第70章 出手阔绰，给寡妇买衣服

第70章 出手阔绰，给寡妇买衣服-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

下一章

“大壮，二壮，红旗，这是你们的。”

李青山先将钱掏了出来，这次上山一共去了三天，一个人按照一天两块钱的分成算，就是六块钱，也就是十八块，要是这次打猎卖货的钱才五十块钱的话，他们三个人就按照其中百分之三十分成，也就是十五块钱，一个人五块钱。

这是上山之前，大壮他们提出来商量好的。

以后先不说，现在李青山必须占大头，否则他们就不跟着上山了，等到以后大家本领练出来之后，钱给多一点，那是没问题的。

“多谢山哥！”

“娘嘞，我从来没拿过这么多钱嘞！”

大壮和赵红旗将钱接到手中后，脸上流露出一抹惊喜道。

这钱，终于到手了啊！！

大壮和二壮这两个家伙打算买点零嘴之类的东西，赵红旗打算买点米面粮油回去，这六块钱就算是卖大米，也能买四五十斤，要是面粉就更便宜一点了。

这次一共卖了一百九十五块钱，给大壮他们分成后，还剩下一百七十七块钱！

这只是其中的一部分。

比如说水獭皮，狍子皮，麝香这东西还没卖呢，光是水獭就能又卖九十多块钱，麝香这东西得去黑市才知道多少钱，但是肯定比黄金贵。

“呦，这么多钱呢？”

梦倩见到李青山手中一扎钱后，眼前一亮，颇为惊讶道。

眼前的李青山穿着破破烂烂，看起来还是个农村的，没想到竟然能拿得出这么多钱？

就算是自己供销社的供销员，一个月工资才二十来块钱，得大半年才能攒到这么多钱呢！

供销社得主任，一个月工资三四十！

等到明年，全部施行公社化后，公社书记主任，工资有六十块钱左右，副主任则是有五十块钱左右，一些公社内负责各个部门的助理，一个月则是三十多块钱。

还有公社内的广播员，卫生员这些，也有二十块钱左右的收入，但没有供销社的供销员工资多，好处是不用下地干活，体力劳动，日子倒也是悠闲。

现在国企的员工，一个月工资二十五块钱左右！

如今，大部分地区都在实行高级合作社的模式，但是土乡一直没有施行，在全国各地这种情况都极其少，等到明年的时候，公社化运行，直接开始了公社化。

现在的情况，就是农村和国企员工这些工资相差极其大。

也是为什么后来很多农村户口，削尖了脑袋，也想成为城市户口的原因，这个时候很多城市户口的人只有娶不到媳妇了，才想着去娶农村的媳妇，而农村的女人，也是削尖了脑袋想要嫁给城里的男人。

当然了，这个城里的男人，是指国企工作的男人，有工作的男人。

Chapter 70: Spending a lot of money to buy clothes for the widow - "Going to the Mountain 1957: Two pounds of pork in exchange for a wife"

"Big Zhuang, Second Strong, Red Flag, this is yours."

Li Qingshan took out the money first. He went up the mountain for three days in total. One person would be divided according to two yuan a day, which is six yuan, which is eighteen yuan. If the money from hunting and selling goods this time was only fifty yuan, the three of them would be divided according to thirty percent, which is fifteen yuan, five yuan per person.

This was something Da Zhuang and the others had discussed before going up the mountain.

Let’s not talk about it later, now Li Qingshan must take the majority, otherwise they will not follow them up the mountain. After everyone has mastered their skills in the future, it will be no problem to give them more money.

"Thank you, Brother Shan!"

"Mom, I have never received so much money!"

After Da Zhuang and Zhao Hongqi received the money, there was a hint of surprise on their faces.

I finally got this money!!

The two guys, Da Zhuang and Er Zhuang, planned to buy some snacks and the like, while Zhao Hongqi planned to buy some rice, flour, grain and oil to go home. Even if the rice was sold for six yuan, it could buy forty or fifty kilograms, and flour would be cheaper.

This time, a total of one hundred and ninety-five yuan was sold. After giving Dazhuang and the others a share, there was still one hundred and seventy-seven yuan left!

This is just part of it.

For example, otter skins, roe deer skins, and musk are not sold yet. Otters alone can be sold for more than ninety yuan. You have to go to the black market to know how much musk costs, but it is definitely more expensive than gold.

"Hey, where's this much money?"

When Meng Qian saw a bunch of money in Li Qingshan's hand, her eyes lit up and she was quite surprised.

The Li Qingshan in front of him was dressed in rags and looked like he was from a rural area. He didn't expect that he could get so much money?

Even if you are a salesperson in your own supply and marketing cooperative, your monthly salary is only about 20 yuan, and it will take you more than half a year to save so much money!

Being the director of a supply and marketing cooperative will earn you thirty or forty dollars a month!

When all communes are implemented next year, the salary of the secretary and director of the commune will be about 60 yuan, and the salary of the deputy director will be about 50 yuan. Some assistants in charge of various departments in the commune will earn more than 30 yuan a month.

There are also broadcasters and health workers in communes who also earn about 20 yuan, but their wages are not as high as those of supply and marketing workers in supply and marketing cooperatives. The advantage is that they don't have to work in the fields, manual labor, and their lives are leisurely.

Now employees of state-owned enterprises earn about 25 yuan a month!

Nowadays, most areas are implementing the advanced cooperative model, but Tuxiang has not implemented it. This situation is extremely rare in all parts of the country. By next year, communeization will be implemented and communeization will begin directly.

The current situation is that the salary gap between rural and state-owned enterprise employees is extremely large.

This is also the reason why many people with rural registered permanent residence later wanted to become urban registered residents. At this time, many people with urban registered permanent residence thought of marrying rural wives only when they couldn't find a wife. And rural women also wanted to marry urban men.

Of course, men in this city refer to men who work in state-owned enterprises, men who have jobs.
